description: Close a status page incident with a final "resolved" update. Same as add_status_page_incident_update with status "resolved"; refuses an incident that is already resolved.

language.description: Two-letter code of the language the text is written in. Defaults to the language of the incident title.

message.description: Public closing note, e.g. "A fix has been deployed and error rates are back to normal."

notify_subscribers.description: Email/SMS/Slack/Teams the status page subscribers. Default true.

name: resolve_status_page_incident
title: Resolve status page incident
